name: Same name as another creature you control or a creature card in your graveyard
notes: Liara of the Flaming Fist's combat trigger and Unexpected Allies read "it has the same name as another creature you control or a creature card in your graveyard". Two Grizzly Bears and a Goblin Guide on the battlefield, a Raging Goblin card in your graveyard and a Goblin Guide card in the opponent's: each Bears gets +1/+1, Goblin Guide does not (its namesake is in the opponent's graveyard); Raging Goblin on the battlefield gets +1/+1 from Liara and first strike from Unexpected Allies (a Raging Goblin card is in your graveyard): 1/1 +1/+1 +2/+0.

scryfallData.name: Liara of the Flaming Fist
scryfallData.oracle_text:
At the beginning of each combat, each creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn if it has the same name as another creature you control or a creature card in your graveyard.
{1}{R}{W}: Another target nontoken creature you control gains first strike and double team until end of turn. Activate only as a sorcery and only once.
scryfallData.flavor_text: "It's a ghoul-eat-you world out there. Follow my orders if you want to survive."
